# Graph and EWS keep distinct retry decisions behind the shared sender

Graph's response processor handles HTTP 429 with per-operation exponential backoff from 30 seconds to one hour. EWS separately extracts SOAP busy delays, including responses delivered with HTTP 500. Both return Duration to the shared sender, which serializes error handling and sleeps before retrying. These guessed Graph defaults and historical review reports are not verified service limits. The patch does not add Retry-After handling or a retry-exhaustion test.

Scope: Exchange protocol response processing.
